tagline.en: Minimum Assured Pension of ₹3,000 per month after 60 years of age.

source.quote: Income Limit: Monthly income should be ₹15,000 or less.

Workers engaged in professions such as: o Street vendors, rag pickers, rickshaw pullers o Construction workers, daily wage labourers o Agricultural workers, beedi workers o Domestic workers, weavers, artisans, fishermen, leather workers, etc.
Should not be covered under the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), or National Pension Scheme (NPS).
Should not be an income taxpayer.
